summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting to be held September 11, 2026, and a proposed increase in authorized share capital to US$5,000,000 for long-term strategic growth. The agenda includes election of up to seven directors, ratification of auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers Taiwan, and approval of director compensation. The record date is July 31, 2026. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are involved. This filing describes routine governance matters and a capital structure change without immediate issuance plans, not a special situation event.
